# GK repository instructions

Read the root `AGENTS.md`, `.copilot-instructions.md` and
`AGENT_EDITING_RULES.md`. For fictional content, the single canonical policy is
`brand-canon/CANON_POLICY.md`; start/resume reconciliation at
`brand-canon/wiki-rewrites/issue-1458-progress.md`.

W81 is foundational truth. Reconcile old and modern stories deliberately;
preserve approved adult fiction and record every substantive source/decision.
Read current dependent articles before editing. Specific GK approval is needed
before publishing major scripture, chronology, identity or Forty-slot changes.
No direct push to main, automatic merge or production deployment.
